sentences.text: Adlercreutzia equolifaciens is an asaccharolytic, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming bacterium founded on strains that metabolize isoflavones to equol and were isolated from human faeces.
A study of trans-resveratrol metabolism identified Adlercreutzia equolifaciens as a producer of dihydroresveratrol from this dietary stilbene.
A study of primary sclerosing cholangitis reported decreased abundance of Adlercreutzia equolifaciens in patients.
